mapper.select: SELECT AL.ACTIVITY_LOG_ID AS activityLogId, AL.TARGET_TYPE AS targetType, AL.TARGET_ID AS targetId, AL.ACTION_TYPE AS actionType, AL.ACTOR_USER_ID AS actorUserId, U.USER_NAME AS userName, AL.BEFORE_VALUE AS beforeValue, AL.AFTER_VALUE AS afterValue, TO_CHAR(AL.CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS createdAt, AL.PROJECT_ID AS projectId FROM ACTIVITY_LOGS AL LEFT JOIN USERS U ON U.USER_ID = AL.ACTOR_USER_ID WHERE AL.PROJECT_ID = #{projectId} ORDER BY AL.CREATED_AT DESC
